webster.text: Conducted with tumult; disorderly; as a tumultuous conflict; a tumultuous retreat.

example.quote: In objection to increasing the representation, it has also been observed, that it is difficult to assemble a hundred men or more without making them tumultuous and a mere mob; reason and experience do not support this observation.
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter X, Jan. 7, 1788
